subject: world_language
concept: Unit review and mastery check for persuasive writing, complex sentences, formal correspondence, revision, and presentation skills, confirming CEFR B2 threshold, and full Grade 8 World Languages year-end review
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any single external curriculum

exercise.pictorial: Mixed set of persuasive-thesis and complex-sentence questions spanning nodes 01-07
exercise.abstract: Mixed formal correspondence, revision, presentation, and combined-project questions spanning nodes 01-07

assessment.mastery_threshold: 8/10 correct across mixed question types, plus a passing combined written/spoken project
misconception_flags: any single-node misconception flag from 01-07 recurring at this stage

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
next_node_on_fail: WORLDLANG.G8.ADVANCED_COMPOSITION.REVIEW (targeted remediation, routes to specific failed sub-node)
